basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Aircraft Division, Nasik wants one Physiotherapist on part-time / visit basis for its Industrial Health Centre at Ojhar Township. Applications go in the prescribed format by post, courier or by hand to Manager (HR), HAL Aircraft Division, Nasik, and must be received by 03.12.2026. Applications by E-mail are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: About the Employer
content_sections.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is described in the notice as a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India. It has 20 Divisions and 10 R&D Centers across 7 States and 10 geographical locations. The Aircraft Division at Ojhar, Nasik has a full-fledged multi-specialty Industrial Health Centre, where this post sits.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled-in application in the prescribed format on A4 size paper (the notice says it is attached) by post, courier or by hand to the address below. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. Manager (HR), Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Aircraft Division, Ojhar Township Post Office, Tal Niphad, Nasik – 422 207. Applicants must clearly indicate the expected remuneration per visit in the application form, considering minimum 03 visits per week. The application must be received by 03.12.2026; HAL is not responsible for delay in receipt or loss in postal transit. Queries about filling the application: 02550-272545.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Bachelor in Physiotherapy / Master in Physiotherapy from recognized Institution. Experience: Minimum 01 Year post qualification experience. Age limit: Upper age limit 40 Years (as on date of Advt.). The notice prints no age relaxation. Visits: Maximum 03 visits per week, minimum 04 hours per visit. Nationality: Only Indian nationals will be considered. Qualifications must be from Indian Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate statutory authorities. Only regular / full time qualifications count. Qualifications through part time, correspondence, distance education or E-learning courses are not eligible. Conveyance reimbursement (per visit) is payable as per applicable HAL rules at the time of engagement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.pay: Remuneration per visit, fixed by HAL

content_sections.heading: HAL Physiotherapist Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out routine physiotherapy activities like SWD, Microwave, TENS, ILT, ICT, Infrared, IFT, Wax bath, CPM, Ultrasound, Electrical stimulator and exercises for indoor and outdoor patients. Visit the Industrial Health Centre on suitable days as per the Division's requirements, on intimation from the Chief of Medical Services (CoMS). May be requested to attend emergencies at the IHC, HAL Nasik Division.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of proof of age (Matriculation Certificate / Birth Certificate). Self-attested copies of Educational Qualification certificates. Self-attested copies of the marks secured in the qualifying examinations. Self-attested copies of Post Qualification Experience documents. Other relevant documents (if any). Originals of the relevant certificates / documents are to be produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview, conducted at HAL Hospital, Ojhar Township. Final selection is based on performance in the interview. The interview schedule and exact timing will be intimated to shortlisted candidates by E-mail only, so applicants need a valid E-mail Id. HAL is not responsible for bouncing of any E-mail.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The initial engagement is for 2 (Two) years. An extension may be considered based on the requirement of the Hospital and performance, which the Head of the Hospital assesses. The engagement is purely temporary and gives no right to the status of a regular employee. No allowance or benefit other than those stated above is payable. Income Tax, Service Tax, Professional Tax etc. are deducted from the remuneration as per applicable rules. The engagement ends automatically at the end of the tenure in the engagement letter. It can end earlier with one-month written notice by either side, or payment of consolidated remuneration equal to 7 visits in lieu of notice. The Visiting Physiotherapist must follow Company Rules and Regulations and keep official matters confidential.
